connectorUiConfig.title: Pulumi Cloud Audit Logs
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The Pulumi Cloud Audit Logs connector provides the capability to ingest [Pulumi Cloud audit log events](https://www.pulumi.com/docs/pulumi-cloud/audit-logs/) into Microsoft Sentinel. By connecting Pulumi Cloud audit logs to Microsoft Sentinel, you can monitor infrastructure-as-code operations, detect unauthorized access attempts, track organization membership changes, and investigate security incidents.

This connector polls the Pulumi Cloud REST API to retrieve audit log events for your organization.

sampleQueries.description: Authorization failures (actions attempted without the required permission)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: Pulumi Cloud access token
customs.description: A Pulumi Cloud [personal access token](https://www.pulumi.com/docs/pulumi-cloud/access-management/access-tokens/) with permissions to read audit logs is required. The organization must be on a Pulumi Cloud edition that includes audit log export (Pro or above).

instructionSteps.title: Connect Pulumi Cloud Audit Logs to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
Provide your Pulumi Cloud organization name and access token to start ingesting audit log events.

1. Create a [Pulumi access token](https://app.pulumi.com/account/tokens) with audit log read permissions.
2. Enter your Pulumi organization name and access token below.
3. Enter the Pulumi API URL: `https://api.pulumi.com` for managed Pulumi Cloud, or the API endpoint of your self-hosted Pulumi Cloud instance.

parameters.title: Connect Pulumi Cloud Organization
parameters.subtitle: Add a Pulumi Cloud organization to ingest its audit log events

dataFlows.transformKql: source | extend TimeGenerated = datetime(1970-01-01) + tolong(timestamp) * 1s | project TimeGenerated, Timestamp_d = tolong(timestamp), SourceIP_s = tostring(sourceIP), Event_s = tostring(event), Description_s = tostring(description), UserName_s = tostring(user.name), UserLogin_s = tostring(user.githubLogin), UserAvatarUrl_s = tostring(user.avatarUrl), TokenID_s = iff(isnull(tokenID), "", tostring(tokenID)), TokenName_s = iff(isnull(tokenName), "", tostring(tokenName)), ActorName_s = tostring(actorName), ActorUrn_s = tostring(actorUrn), RequireOrgAdmin_b = iff(isnull(reqOrgAdmin), false, tobool(reqOrgAdmin)), RequireStackAdmin_b = iff(isnull(reqStackAdmin), false, tobool(reqStackAdmin)), AuthFailure_b = iff(isnull(authFailure), false, tobool(authFailure))

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: The timestamp (UTC) when the audit log event occurred.

columns.name: Timestamp_d
columns.description: Original Unix epoch seconds of the event.

columns.name: SourceIP_s
columns.description: IP address of the client that triggered the event.

columns.name: Event_s
columns.description: Audit log event type identifier (e.g., stack-created, member-added).

columns.name: UserName_s
columns.description: Display name of the user who performed the action.

columns.name: UserLogin_s
columns.description: GitHub login of the user who performed the action.

columns.name: UserAvatarUrl_s
columns.description: Avatar URL of the user who performed the action.

columns.name: TokenID_s
columns.description: ID of the access token used, if applicable.

columns.name: TokenName_s
columns.description: Name of the access token used, if applicable.

columns.name: ActorName_s
columns.description: Display name of a non-human actor (e.g., deploy token).

columns.name: ActorUrn_s
columns.description: Pulumi URN of a non-human actor.

columns.name: RequireOrgAdmin_b
columns.description: Whether the action required organization admin privileges.

columns.name: RequireStackAdmin_b
columns.description: Whether the action required stack admin privileges.

columns.name: AuthFailure_b
columns.description: Whether the event represents a failed authentication attempt.

properties.description: AuthenticationFailures_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

Detects when there are more than 5 failed Pulumi Cloud login attempts (user-login-failed events) from a single IP address within a 1-hour window. This may indicate a brute force attack or compromised credentials.
properties.query:
PulumiAuditLogs_CL
| where Event_s == "user-login-failed"
| summarize FailCount = count(), StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated) by SourceIP_s
| where FailCount > 5

properties.description: OrgMemberChanges_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0

Detects when organization membership changes occur, including members being added, removed, or having their roles changed. These events are important for tracking access control changes to your infrastructure management platform.
StackDeletion_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.0
Detects when a Pulumi stack is deleted. Stack deletion is a destructive operation that removes all infrastructure state. This may be legitimate maintenance or could indicate unauthorized activity.

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The Pulumi Cloud Audit Logs solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables ingestion of audit log events from Pulumi Cloud into Microsoft Sentinel through the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF). It provides security monitoring and compliance auditing for infrastructure-as-code operations, covering authentication activity, organization membership changes, stack lifecycle operations, and access token usage. The solution includes analytic rules for failed login attempts, stack deletion, and organization membership changes. Pulumi documentation: https://www.pulumi.com/docs/pulumi-cloud/audit-logs/

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

  • Microsoft Sentinel
  • Azure Monitor Logs
  • Data Collection Rules (DCR)
  • Codeless Connector Framework (CCF)

Dependencies:

  • A Pulumi Cloud organization on an edition that includes audit log export (Pro or above)
  • A Pulumi Cloud access token with permissions to read audit logs

Data Connectors: 1, Analytic Rules: 3
